items.title: Pink Responds To Backlash Over Sharing Anti-Macklemore Post About Israel
items.summary: Pink has been catching heat after resharing an Instagram post that criticized Macklemore's pro-Palestine performance at Ed Sheeran's concert. Today, the pop singer made a lengthy statement responding to the backlash, saying that "Palestinians deserve a future that honors their humanity and their aspirations" but "Hamas is a terrorist organization." The post Pink Responds To Backlash Over Sharing Anti-Macklemore Post About Israel appeared first on Stereogum .

(SML, Jeff Parker's ETA IVtet, Makaya McCraven, Jason Isbell, boygenius, Neko Case, Flea... the list goes on.) Butterrs also makes solo albums, though as you might expect, they tend to feature a bunch of the other great musicians in their orbit. The post Anna Butterss – “Ninths” appeared first on Stereogum .
